latest_release.name: v9.7.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Add support for 4 Ignore List/Git Config filenames by @Alhadis in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8020
* Speedup gem loading by @byroot in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8010
* Test against Ruby 3.4 and 4.0 by @byroot in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8011
* Add Blueprint language by @kaypes in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8001
* Change the C# colour to purple by @violetshine in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8026
* Add Gno language support by @karagozemin in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8077
* Switch Carbon language to upstream grammar. by @zygoloid in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8024
* Add `.secrets.baseline` as generated JSON by @jonathandung in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8022
* Tighten Lambdapi pattern by @nickswalker in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8018
* Update Gno language color by @karagozemin in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8081
* Fix Git LFS pointer detection and exclusion by @DecimalTurn in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8085
* Identify ruby code generated by protoc-gen-twirp as generated by @offbyone in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8088
* Add test validating language_id on new language additions by @lildude in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8079
* Rebuild the published Docker image on a supported Ruby, and pin the gem to the release by @kobihikri in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8100
* Add ucode language by @janeblower in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8043
* Detect TypeScript with node shebang as TypeScript by @mondeja in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/7919
* Rename SaltStack to Salt and update language colour by @jleroy in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8029
* Add Tolk language by @0xnirapod in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8033
* Add JASS progamming language by @Drake53 in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8096
* Add common AutoHotkey extensions by @Banaanae in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/6815
* Add .hujson as extension for JSONC by @kevinji in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/7051
* Lobster language support by @inferrna in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/7204
* Add support for MiniScript by @ayecue in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/7384
* Add support for Verse programming language by @simnJS in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/7440
* Add `.pacscript` to Shell by @Elsie19 in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/7443
* Add BIRD2 language by @Alice39s in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/7513
* Add Tape language support by @aryansk in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8103
* Fix .al heuristic: add profileextension, anchor to line start by @SShadowS in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8108
* Add BBCode language by @Nixinova in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/7581
* Add Roblox `.rbxmx` as XML by @gords2 in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8032
* Add Aleo instructions by @d0cd in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/6969
* Added support for ImHex's Pattern Language by @WerWolv in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/7411
* Add B programming language by @aceinetx in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8056
* Add support for 3 new extensions and 7 filenames by @Alhadis in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8118
* Add FPP (F Prime Prime) language by @thomas-bc in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8136
* Rename "Vim Script" to "Vim script" by @h-east in https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/pull/8124
* Detect PL/pgSQL by its DO block rather than by dollar quoting by @v
